info.name: Returns list of usage limits for the subscription Id.

params.name: compartmentId
params.description: The OCID of the root compartment.

params.name: subscriptionId
params.description: The subscription ID for which usage limits information is requested for.

params.name: limitType
params.description: Hard or soft limit. Hard limits lead to breaches, soft to alerts.

params.name: page
params.description: The value of the 'opc-next-page' response header from the previous call.

params.name: limit
params.description: The maximum number of items to return in the paginated response.

params.name: sortOrder
params.description: The sort order to use, which can be ascending (ASC) or descending (DESC).

params.name: sortBy
params.description: The field to sort by. Supports one sort order.

items.docs: Returns the list of usage limits for the subscription ID and tenant ID.
